{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute conversion rate: fraction of loyal customers who converted
converted_count = loyal_df['converted'].sum()
total_loyal = len(loyal_df)
conversion_rate = converted_count / total_loyal

# Print evidence
print(f"Converted count (loyal): {converted_count}")
print(f"Total loyal customers: {total_loyal}")
print(f"Conversion rate (fraction): {conversion_rate}")"}
